title: A theme widget bypasses analytics denial

input.scope: Synthetic supplied artifacts only. Inspect offline. No live actions are authorized.

findings.observation: The review widget sends a synthetic analytics event after rejection, contrary to the storefront explanation.
findings.classification: Observed technical gap. Legal applicability and phase require separate assessment.

unknowns: Initial, withdrawal, revisit and other region behavior are unverified.
forbidden_claims: Because the widget is for reviews, its recorded analytics request is necessary to fulfill orders.
plan_acceptance_checks: Merchant developer and app owner retest widget opening before choice and after rejection, acceptance, withdrawal and revisit with the same endpoint monitored.
